title: Vortex Raspberry Mojito 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Raspberry Mojito combines the sweetness of ripe Raspberry with the zesty tang of Lime and a fresh hint of Mint. This cocktail-inspired e-liquid delivers a crisp and flavourful vape, offering layers of fruit and mint for a unique and refreshing experience. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices, providing smooth vapour production and full-bodied flavour. The nic salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, perfect for everyday use. Presented in a 10ml format, Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts are a more sustainable and cost-effective alternative to disposable vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Raspberry Mojito is a fantastic option for vapers who enjoy fruity, minty blends.
